title: Dragon Fire Buddy Rushing, Part 2
description: B-roll of the Combined Arms Training Center Camp Fuji, Japan, U.S. Marines of Combat Logistics Company 36 practice buddy rushing and fire the M-240B Crew Served Weapon during Exercise Dragon Fire.  Dragon Fire is an annual Combat Training Exercise CLC-36 conducts in order for Marines to handle different weapons and practice executing combat military operations.  Scenes include Various shots with helmet camera of Marine firing weapon, clearing a weapon, conducting buddy rushes and prone firing. Produced by Cpl. Andrea M. Olguin. Part 2 of 2. Also available in High Definition.
